rationale.source_fidelity: Both outputs preserve the fixture's exact figures, command and uncertainty.
rationale.semantic_yield: B adds an evidence-bounded tension-to-outcome narrative and a reusable concept instead of beginning with bookkeeping cards.
rationale.actionability: Both expose an untested procedure; B binds pre-snapshot, exit code, hard-gate checks and rollback more tightly.
rationale.reader_efficiency: A prints the full administrative header on every card; B moves canonical metadata to CARD_META and begins with a human entry card.
rationale.reusability: B exposes dependency provenance and machine sidecars needed for later validation.
rationale.anti_fragmentation: Both keep CASE-FRAG-001 coherent; this one fixture does not demonstrate a clear winner on fragmentation.
rationale.epistemic_honesty: Both keep the 41% claim source-supported rather than tested and keep the command UNTESTED.
